questions.prompt: Before relying on “Kaiming initialization”, what should a learner verify?
options: Use the held-out test split repeatedly to tune the model and report that score as unbiased.
Skip recording package versions because they cannot affect API or device behavior.
compare variants on identical data splits, seeds, metrics, and budget; verify output shape before training.
Assume all tensor dimensions and devices are interchangeable without checking them.
questions.answer_key: compare variants on identical data splits, seeds, metrics, and budget; verify output shape before training.

questions.prompt: Which pitfall matters when applying “Activation and initialization compatibility”?
options: Catch every exception and silently replace failed results with zeros.
Do not attribute performance differences to architecture if datasets, preprocessing, training time, or evaluation protocols also changed.
Change several unrelated settings at once and infer which change fixed the result.
Treat successful imports as proof that the full model and evaluation pipeline are correct.
questions.answer_key: Do not attribute performance differences to architecture if datasets, preprocessing, training time, or evaluation protocols also changed.
questions.explanation: This topic-specific caution is important: Do not attribute performance differences to architecture if datasets, preprocessing, training time, or evaluation protocols also changed.
